titleZh: 磊的日记:我和伊森的"家务战争"
goalZh: 读懂一篇按时间顺序写的幽默日记,说出事情的起因、经过和结果
canDoZh: 能读懂一篇带点幽默的日记,说出事情的起因、经过和结果

newItems.noteZh: have a fight 吵了一架;gh 不发音,读 /faɪt/。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Friday night. This week was crazy!
lines.zh: (磊的日记)周五晚上。这一周太疯狂了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: First, Ethan ate my spicy noodles from Mom.
lines.zh: 先是伊森吃了妈妈寄来的辣面条。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Then we wrote a roommate agreement, and we signed it.
lines.zh: 后来我们写了一份室友公约,两个人都签了名。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: On Tuesday, I washed my white T-shirts with Ethan's red sock.
lines.zh: 周二,我把白 T 恤和伊森的红袜子一起洗了。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Now they're pink. Ethan loves his new pink T-shirt.
lines.zh: 现在它们都是粉色的了。伊森很喜欢他那件"新"粉 T 恤。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: On Wednesday, my spicy chicken made a lot of smoke.
lines.zh: 周三,我炒辣子鸡冒了好多烟。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: The fire alarm was so loud!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: That night, our heater made a strange noise.
lines.zh: 那天夜里,我们的暖气又发出怪声。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Finally, today was the inspection, and we passed!
lines.zh: 最后,今天查房,我们通过了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Ethan isn't very neat, and he plays video games all night.
lines.zh: 伊森不太爱整洁,还整晚打游戏。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: But he's a great roommate, and now we're good friends.
lines.zh: 不过他是个很好的室友,现在我们是好朋友。

questions.prompt: 这一周的"家务战争"是怎么开始的?
questions.explainZh: First, Ethan ate my spicy noodles from Mom. We had a big fight.——伊森吃了磊妈妈寄来的辣面条。

questions.prompt: 磊的白 T 恤为什么变成了粉色?
options: 和伊森的红袜子一起洗了
questions.explainZh: I washed my white T-shirts with Ethan's red sock.——和红袜子一起洗了。

options: 磊炒辣子鸡烟太大,火警响了
questions.explainZh: On Wednesday, my spicy chicken made a lot of smoke. The fire alarm was so loud!——查房是周五(today)。

questions.prompt: 最后磊觉得伊森怎么样?
options: 不太整洁,但是个很好的室友
questions.explainZh: Ethan isn't very neat… But he's a great roommate, and now we're good friends.——but 后面是磊真正想说的。

grammar.titleZh: 日记:按时间顺序讲一周的事
grammar.bodyZh: 日记讲这一周发生的事,用一般过去时,再用顺序词和时间串起来:First…(先是)、Then…(然后)、On Tuesday… / On Wednesday… / That night…(那天夜里)、Finally…(最后)。说现在的情况、对人的看法,换回一般现在时:Ethan isn't very neat, but he's a great roommate.。复习不规则过去式:eat → ate、have → had、write → wrote、make → made。

examples.text: First, Ethan ate my spicy noodles.
examples.zh: 先是伊森吃了我的辣面条。

examples.text: Then we wrote a roommate agreement.
examples.zh: 后来我们写了一份室友公约。

examples.text: Finally, today was the inspection, and we passed!
examples.zh: 最后,今天查房,我们通过了!
